FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Have questions? We have answers. If you don't find what you're looking for, contact our team.

Bolna AI starts at $0.06 per minute (about ₹5.52) on pay-as-you-go, with speech-to-text, the LLM and text-to-speech included when your agent uses the bundled models. Telephony and the platform fee are added per minute. Larger top-ups bring the rate down to about 4.5¢ (₹4.15) per minute, the Pilot plan locks in about 4.2¢ (~₹4), and every new account gets $5 in free credits.
The Pilot plan is a one-time purchase at a fixed per-minute rate, billed in 30-second pulses. Two tiers are available: $500 for 12,000 minutes (~4.2¢/min) or $300 for 6,500 minutes (~4.6¢/min). Both include up to 25 concurrent calls, enterprise features, and one month of dedicated support — a WhatsApp channel with our team plus four 1:1 calls with your POC. You build your own agent in Agent Studio. Your rate holds until the minutes are used up, and any unused wallet balance carries over; after that the account reverts to standard pricing from 6¢/minute.
With transparent token-based pricing, you only pay for what you actually consume. Purchase credits starting from $10 to $5000, and top up whenever your balance runs low. Every API call is billed based on the exact number of tokens processed, giving you complete visibility and control over your costs.
Yes! We support BYOK (Bring Your Own Keys) for LLM providers, TTS, and ASR services. By using your own API keys, you can significantly reduce costs while still leveraging our powerful voice AI platform and infrastructure. This gives you maximum flexibility and cost control.
Your agents will stop making calls when credits run out. You can set up automatic top-ups or receive notifications when your balance is low to ensure uninterrupted service.
Yes! We offer enterprise plans and volume discounts based on your committed usage. Contact our sales team to discuss custom pricing tailored to your specific needs.
Yes! We offer $5 in free credits when you sign up. This gives you the opportunity to test our platform and experience the service firsthand before committing to a larger purchase.
